unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_bytes: No available collector measures per-collective wire/PCIe/NVLink bytes; observations.json shows transport SHM/direct/direct, and deriving traffic from logical payload sizes (28351488/157541376 B) or memcpy sizes would be invention; device_telemetry (not selected) only supplies device-wide readings with native windows.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_transfer_split: Nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer; only bounds obtainable from cross-rank aligned entries plus the same-size reference experiment (collective_calibration), not a split.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.per_parameter_group_cost_allocation_with: observations.json bucket inventory states direct parameter ownership is many-to-many and no collector allocates one timed collective's cost among its member parameter groups.
unavailable_fields.first_numerical_divergence_site: candidate_diagnostics does not compare intermediate tensors or locate first numerical divergence, and no other selected collector supplies it; evaluation.json endpoint already passed full quality checks, so the dimension is not decision-relevant here.

rationale: Revision 03c5e5abcdf4f4cf519e4e909e2b48a3d8e54414dd924a31dabd04f5f3878fbb is the only listed candidate and it failed the frozen step_ms constraint (max-rank 144.138 ms vs limit 138.660 ms = 1.05 x 132.057 original reference) while reducing max-rank communication_kernel_sum_ms (64.149 vs 74.676). Parent discovery shows 13 SUM allreduces (12 x 28,351,488 B + 1 x 157,541,376 B, fp32) all running ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL over SHM/direct, with strong rank asymmetry (rank0 kernel sum 58.9 ms vs rank1 200.6 ms; ~3.2 ms vs ~14.4 ms per 28 MB bucket, i.e. device waiting included) and communication almost fully exposed (rank0 compute overlap 4.37 of 58.9 ms). The candidate's equalized per-rank comm (63.4/64.1 ms) matches its declared 'aligned_final_backward_barrier' route (2 invocations), but that label is candidate-reported telemetry. Observed uncertainty: (1) what the candidate actually executed on this exact candidate and whether the route claim and zero fallbacks hold; (2) how much of the ~+12 ms step regression is additive bundle binding overhead (direct binding over a bundle-free parent) versus the alignment barrier itself versus host dispatch/synchronization changes; (3) whether the remaining ~64 ms comm kernel sum is transfer-dominated for RING_LL over SHM at the observed sizes and whether actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions differ. Selections: candidate_diagnostics (executed calls, handled exceptions with traceback locations, scalar returns) to corroborate route telemetry with actual call evidence; binding_cost (applicable: candidate is additive over a bundle-free parent with direct binding) to separate binding overhead from algorithm cost in clean AB/BA workers with full quality checks; execution_timeline for CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals placing the added wall time; nsys for device-side overlap/exposure and barrier-serialization attribution on the candidate; nccl_tuning because kernel entry names alone do not identify actual protocol/channel decisions at 28,351,488/157,541,376 B; collective_calibration as a same-size full-world SUM allreduce reference with correctness checks to contextualize in-situ kernel durations (reference experiment, not a lower bound). Excluded: torch (already ran); python_runtime (perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean; host cost is covered by binding_cost and execution_timeline); device_telemetry (device-wide PCIe/utilization windows cannot attribute per-collective time and transport is SHM). No failure-category policy or optimization action is presumed.
